summary: Inspected the assigned product-overview reference, rendered and diff crops and checked source records plus current geometry. The outer section geometry passes within 2 px, but the diagnostic crop difference is 16.343% and the visible product data, controls and typography do not reproduce the source state.
issues: VIS-PRODUCT-OVERVIEW-001 | priority critical | property product price/content | expected: selected 5 L state at 411,00 zł with crossed-out 530,00 zł, VAT note and 30-day-low copy | actual: generic 82,20 zł–1.644,00 zł range with sale, tax and 30-day-low presentation absent | fix: render the source-backed selected variation state and its sale-price metadata.

VIS-PRODUCT-OVERVIEW-002 | priority critical | property native controls/structure | expected: 1 L, 5 L and 20 L option buttons, quantity stepper, green cart control, substitutes row, rating and favorite action | actual: unstyled required-select label/value and purple disabled-looking cart control, with the remaining controls absent | fix: expose and style the actual WooCommerce variation and cart controls and restore the source-backed auxiliary rows.

VIS-PRODUCT-OVERVIEW-003 | priority high | property markup/typography/spacing | expected: 48 px-like bold title and clean SKU line followed by the full vertically distributed overview | actual: materially smaller/light title, literal
displayed after SKU and content compressed into the top half | fix: remove escaped markup leakage and match source typography and internal layout.
